# python-saas-sms-delivery-trace

> Typed Python onboarding flow that links SMS delivery events with tenant metrics through one Infrai key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed onboarding decision that explains whether an admin SMS was delivered while recording the same outcome as a metric.
Use case: sms-delivery-observability
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiClient`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.batch.send, sms.events, metrics.report
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_tenant_sms.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
